description: Build a rotating shift schedule: set days-on / days-off, the start date and shift pattern to get a dated roster with on/off days.

faqs.a: Any N-days-on / M-days-off rotation — 4-on/4-off, 5-on/2-off, 2-on/2-off — over any date range up to 120 days.
Day shifts, night shifts, or alternating day/night for each working day.

faqs.q: Does the rotation continue across months?
faqs.a: Yes — the on/off cycle runs continuously from the start date regardless of month or year boundaries.

howto: Enter days on and days off (e.g. 4 on / 4 off).
Choose day, night or alternating shifts, and how many days to show.
Read the dated roster with every on/off day and shift labelled.
title: Shift Scheduler
